articles.title: The crypto industry has found new ways to grow. Making money from them is another story
articles.snippet: Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle are expanding into stablecoins, payments and prediction markets, but their latest earnings show how hard it is to escape crypto's boom-and-bust cycles.

articles.title: Tesla to Wind Down Cybertruck Production as Elon Musk Pivots to Robotaxis and AI
articles.snippet: The Tesla CEO said the Texas plant will make room for the Cybercab, as sales of the stainless-steel pickup run far below capacity.

articles.title: Zcash's NU7 Upgrade Goes Live, Recycling 60% of Fees to Fund Future Block Rewards
articles.snippet: The Network Sustainability Mechanism will reissue removed ZEC from 2031 within the 21 million cap, as the community debates its dev fund.
